rationale.H001: Low layoffs, little-changed hires and nominal house-price resilience preserve the soft-landing path, but weaker vacancies/confidence and high long rates prevent an upgrade.
rationale.H002: Weaker August openings and September confidence increase delayed-downturn risk; low layoffs, stable hires and contained recent credit evidence cap the increase.
rationale.H003: Partial oil-export normalization and softer labor/consumer leading indicators reduce the chance of monotonically intensifying inflation pressure; still-high oil/yields and unresolved core PCE keep H003 narrowly in front.
rationale.H004: No new productivity or output-per-input evidence.
